Done. Added `addLine` and `removeLine` to src/invoices.js with error codes `NOT_DRAFT` and `LINE_NOT_FOUND`:

- `addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })` — adds a new line or increases qty if SKU exists; validates qty and SKU; rejects non-draft
- `removeLine(invoice, sku)` — removes a line by SKU; rejects if not found, if it's the last line, or if not draft

Added 15 tests covering all cases (add new, increment existing, validation errors, non-draft rejection, non-mutation). All 40 tests pass.
